headline: Strategic Posts Change Hands on Several Fronts
war_summary: The war’s 34-town victory standard remains unmet, and no victor is recorded. Most regions show no strategic-base activity in the past day, but several contested sectors are still shifting. Weathered Expanse logged 55 base events in 24 hours, Kuura Strand 31, and Marban Hollow 33; their latest recorded activity came between 19:36 and 20:06 UTC. Nevish Line logged 16 events, including three in the last two hours, while casualty counts and enlistments rose sharply there. Kuura remains divided, with five Colonial-held bases and one Warden-held, amid heavy though recently cooling casualty rates. Pari Peak and Linn Mercy also show mixed ownership and numerous reported shifts over the past day, but their base logs have been quiet in the latest hours. Elsewhere, substantial casualty totals in Callahan’s Passage and Dead Lands have not been accompanied by strategic-base events in the past day. The ledger points to a handful of active, unsettled fronts amid many static maps; enlistment figures are cumulative regional arrivals, not a count of troops presently afield.
